Class GuiUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.client.view.gui.GuiUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class GuiUI extends Object implements UI
JavaFX implementation of the ui interface is represented. Network events are safely routed to the JavaFX application thread. Rendering logic is delegated to the current active view controller.
